findings.title: The name as a raised frame over the scene
findings.claim: Across the supplied S101 sequence, the opening name can be heard as a designation raised over the approaching impact, scattering, and heat, so the basmala becomes a high protective heading while remaining an invocation by God's name.
findings.mechanism: The focus stem سْمِ carries the name/designation relation, the focus proper name fixes the invoked referent, and the supplied S101 walk then repeats the still-unexplained naming of ٱلْقَارِعَةُ before showing scattering and fire; the contact turns the opening from a detached formula into a frame over the scene that follows.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can retain the ordinary meaning while seeing why the opening feels placed above the later catastrophe: a stable act of naming is already present before the event is explained.
findings.containment: This is a qualified contextual framing of the supplied S101 material, not a literal claim that the basmala is a physical cover, not a surah-wide channel decision, and not a replacement for the ordinary invocation.

epistemic.reason: The supplied cross-run publication directly supports the name/frame contact, while the directional arrow from the opening to the later catastrophe is explicitly an inference in the reader walks.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: ad, adlandırma ve ad ya da nitelik bakımından denklik
branch_activations.facet_statement: Ad, bir varlığı tanıtan ve ondan söz etmeyi sağlayan söz veya anlamdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus stem سْمِ ordinarily carries a name or designation that makes a referent speakable.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied target-surah walk presents ٱلْقَارِعَةُ as a repeated name in 101:1-3 before its meaning is unfolded.
branch_activations.activation: The designation carried by سْمِ meets the later repeated act of naming, making the basmala's name function as an orienting heading for an event that is initially left unexplained.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The opening name becomes a stable point from which the later striking event is named and approached.
branch_activations.boundary: The name remains an invocation and designation; this does not claim that every possible meaning of the focus root is active.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: Yaratıcıya özgü ad ile seslenme ve ant biçimleri
branch_activations.facet_statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus word ٱللَّهِ carries the proper name that fixes the address of the opening formula.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied S101 walk places that fixed divine address before the repeated, not-yet-explained naming of ٱلْقَارِعَةُ in 101:1-3.
branch_activations.activation: The exclusive divine name supplies the stable addressee while the later event is named without immediate explanation, so the opening is heard as an addressed frame rather than an unlocated label.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The basmala offers an addressed point of orientation above the unfolding scene.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not assert that the later event is authorized by the formula in a theological or legal sense; it records the supplied framing inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey bulunduğu düzeyden yukarı çıkar veya yüksek duruma gelir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus name carries the supplied pressure of a designation being set high or made prominent.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied walk moves from the repeated striking name in 101:1-3 through the destabilization of 101:4-5 to the heat of 101:11.
branch_activations.activation: The elevated designation meets a sequence that descends into impact, dispersal, and burning, allowing the opening name to be heard as placed above the later scene.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The name has a raised position in the reader's experience: it overarches the movement from impact to fire.
branch_activations.boundary: The elevation is a contextual image of reading position, not a claim about a physical object or an exclusive gloss of the word.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: üstteki gök veya örtü ve buna bağlı üstten gelen ya da üstte bulunan şeyler
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin üzerinde yükselen ve onu örten gök, tavan veya üst yan anlatılır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus name carries the supplied associated image of an upper side or covering position.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The target-surah walk supplies dispersed people and fluffed mountains in 101:4-5 and a concluding fire in 101:11.
branch_activations.activation: The upper or covering pressure of the focus name meets the later downward-facing scene of disaggregation and heat, which makes the opening read like a protective heading over what follows.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The basmala can be perceived as an upper mercy-and-name cover around the supplied catastrophe sequence.
branch_activations.boundary: The cover is an inferred reading relation, not a literal shelter and not a claim that the later scene is prevented or softened.

findings.title: Mercy as a relational frame around disaggregation
findings.claim: The doubled mercy naming can be heard as a relational frame around the supplied scene in which people scatter and mountains lose their cohesion; it makes the opening mercy visible as the lens through which destabilization is encountered.
findings.mechanism: The two focus epithets carry the mercy-and-tenderness relation, and the target-surah sequence independently presents human dispersal in 101:4 and material loosening in 101:5; their contact makes relational care the opening measure for the later loss of cohesion.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the two mercy names matter before the scene of scattering: they give the disaggregation a relational horizon instead of leaving it as bare spectacle.
findings.containment: The frame deepens the ordinary mercy reading and does not claim that mercy prevents the scattering, resolves it, or becomes the surah's sole thesis.

epistemic.reason: The supplied cross-run publication and wide reader walk both anchor the doubled mercy against 101:4-5, while the role of mercy as a lens is marked as an inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir başkasının durumu karşısında yüreğin yumuşaması, ona acıma ve içten yakınlık duyma çekirdeği oluşturur.
branch_activations.carrier: The paired focus epithets carry mercy, tenderness, and inward relational care.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied S101 walk places dispersed people in 101:4 and mountains loosened into fluffed material in 101:5.
branch_activations.activation: Mercy as a relation of care meets two different forms of lost cohesion, making the opening epithets the relational lens through which both dispersals are seen.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The opening mercy names surround the later human and material disaggregation with a compassionate frame.
branch_activations.boundary: The relation does not say that the mercy names cancel the scene, explain its cause, or guarantee protection from it.

findings.title: The mercy field and the reversed mother image
findings.claim: The focus mercy field can be heard alongside the supplied later statement that a person's mother is Hawiyah, so the ordinary expectation of kinship or a womb-like source is turned toward an abyss without displacing the opening mercy.
findings.mechanism: The focus epithets carry the supplied near-kinship and womb facets, while the S101 context at 101:9 supplies the independent mother/source image; the contact reverses an expected containing origin into Hawiyah and makes the opening mercy-field newly sharp by contrast.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel why the later mother image is startling: it is heard against a previously established field of care, nearness, and carrying containment.
findings.containment: This finding follows the explicit retrospective observation in one supplied reader walk; another supplied walk did not retain the kinship/womb activation strongly enough. Both records remain visible through this qualification. The inference is not a claim that رحم literally means mother or abyss.

epistemic.reason: The cross-run publication explicitly supplies the B002/B003-to-101:9 relation, but the reader walks disagree about whether those branches survive as a distinct activation, so the contextual reversal remains qualified.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Ortak soydan gelme, kişiler arasında yakın ve kalıcı bir soy ilişkisi kurar.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus mercy forms carry the supplied image of a close and enduring kin relation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied S101 reader walk identifies 101:9, where the person's mother is named as Hawiyah.
branch_activations.activation: The kinship-bearing pressure of the mercy forms meets the later mother designation and turns an expected source of nearness into an abyssal destination.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The later mother image becomes a reversal that throws the opening kinship expectation into relief.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus forms are not being redefined as the word for mother, and the reversal is not asserted as grammatical meaning.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Dişi bedenindeki bu iç organ, yavrunun oluşup geliştiği yer ve onu karın içinde taşıyan kap işlevindedir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus mercy forms carry the supplied image of an enclosing womb or bearing vessel.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied S101 reader walk identifies the later mother/source phrase at 101:9 and its turn to Hawiyah.
branch_activations.activation: The carrying-container facet meets the later mother/source designation, so what would ordinarily suggest containment is made to terminate in an abyss.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The Hawiyah image becomes a dark reversal of the containing source that the opening mercy field can evoke.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a contextual image relation, not a literal gloss of the mercy epithets and not a claim that every womb association is active.

findings.title: Invocation before the question exceeds ordinary knowing
findings.claim: The divine name in the opening can be heard as an invoked point of address before the supplied S101 sequence asks twice what can make the event known, so the basmala frames the movement from address into knowledge that exceeds ordinary grasp.
findings.mechanism: The focus proper-name branch supplies an addressed divine name, while the target-surah walk supplies the repeated unknowability questions at 101:3 and 101:10; the contact makes invocation the stable entry point before cognition is struck and exceeded.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader perceives the opening as a speech act that prepares the later questions, rather than as a formula unrelated to the problem of knowing what the event is.
findings.containment: The finding does not claim that the basmala itself answers the questions, supplies a complete doctrine of knowledge, or authorizes a single interpretation of the later event. It keeps the ordinary invocation intact.

epistemic.reason: The cross-run publication labels the name-to-entry reading weak and the reader walk identifies the framing direction as abductive, although the two target question locations are explicit in the supplied packet.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: Yaratıcıya özgü ad ile seslenme ve ant biçimleri
branch_activations.facet_statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus word ٱللَّهِ carries the unique divine name used as the formula's addressee.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied S101 walk places 'what makes you know' questions at 101:3 and 101:10, with the event and its answer still beyond ordinary explanation.
branch_activations.activation: The invoked proper name meets the repeated question of knowing, giving the reader an addressed foothold before the text reaches what ordinary inquiry cannot seize.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The opening invocation becomes the entry point into a later disclosure that is announced before it is knowable.
branch_activations.boundary: The relation concerns the reading posture created by the sequence; it does not turn the focus name into a lexical synonym for knowledge or disclosure.

findings.title: Mercy as enacted and wide-reaching care
findings.claim: The wider supplied occurrences make the opening mercy names perceptible as enacted care: mercy is described as taken upon oneself, near to those who do good, and wide enough to encompass everything, so the basmala names an active reach rather than an abstract mood alone.
findings.mechanism: The focus epithets carry the mercy relation and its active result, while the reciprocal targets at 6:12, 6:54, 7:56, and 7:156 independently supply self-assumed, near, and all-encompassing mercy; their contact changes the opening from a static quality into a relation that reaches and acts.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear both mercy names as a mode of divine action with range and proximity, not merely as two ornamental adjectives.
findings.containment: The wider occurrences qualify the opening's mercy field without importing their full contexts into 101:0, and they do not claim uniformity across every occurrence or erase the more local frame around S101's scattering scene.

epistemic.reason: The target texts and the strong/medium reciprocal nominations provide concrete wider triggers, but the packet marks those connections as nominations requiring fresh focus-direction assessment.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bu iç yöneliş, acınan kişiyi esirgemeyi ve ona iyilikte bulunmayı gerektiren etkin bir sonuç taşır.
branch_activations.carrier: The paired focus epithets carry mercy as care that reaches the one toward whom it is directed.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied wider targets describe mercy as written upon the divine self at 6:12 and 6:54, near to the doers of good at 7:56, and encompassing all things at 7:156.
branch_activations.activation: The active-result facet of mercy meets these distinct range and proximity descriptions, making the opening epithets readable as enacted care with both nearness and breadth.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The basmala's mercy names acquire a wider action profile: care reaches, surrounds, and remains available across different human situations.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not flatten the two epithets into one exhaustive doctrine or claim that the focus itself states the later contextual qualifications.

findings.title: The named referent and exclusive worship
findings.claim: The supplied worship passages let the divine name in the opening return as the named referent of exclusive worship, so 'Allah'ın adıyla' can carry a direction toward the one who is worshipped as well as the ordinary act of beginning in God's name.
findings.mechanism: The focus proper name is carried by the supplied worshipped-being branch, while 12:40, 39:11, and 43:45 independently place worship, exclusive service, and rejection of rival deities around Allah or al-Rahman; the contact turns the opening name into a directed relation rather than a bare label.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the name invokes a determinate worship relation: the opening points toward the one to whom service belongs, while still saying only 'in the name of'.
findings.containment: The wider passages supply a contextual resonance, not an added command in 101:0. The packet also contains reverse no-value evidence for some worship links; that asymmetry limits the claim but does not erase the focus-direction contact.

epistemic.reason: A strong 12:40 nomination and medium worship-boundary nominations provide explicit target language, but the reciprocal registry warns that source-direction labels are not focus decisions and that target morphology is not supplied.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus proper name ٱللَّهِ carries the named referent toward whom worship can be directed.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied target passages join Allah or al-Rahman to worship and exclusivity: 12:40 states exclusive worship, 39:11 states commanded worship of Allah, and 43:45 asks about deities worshipped besides al-Rahman.
branch_activations.activation: The worshipped-being facet meets explicit exclusive-worship language around the divine name, allowing the opening name to be heard as oriented toward the one who receives service.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The opening formula carries a latent direction of worship beneath its plain beginning-by-name act.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus remains a naming invocation; it is not being rewritten as an imperative to worship, and the target passages are not claimed as the immediate grammar of 101:0.
